title: v2 — Opções como classe de primeira ordem
summary: Proposal synthesizing a 4-specialist panel review for adding options as a first-class layer on the asset card, covering UX, data model, and agent-loop contracts.
scope: ADR-003 identidade da posição de opção
notes: Ambiguous between SPEC and PRD: doc mixes product-scope decisions (goals/non-goals in secs 1,2,6, UX rationale, out-of-scope list) with strong technical implementation contracts (data model shape in sec 3, endpoint list and agent-loop behavior in sec 9, cost table in sec 5). Classified SPEC per precedence rule (SPEC > PRD) due to the data model schema, endpoint contracts, and agent.py cycle changes being load-bearing implementation detail rather than pure user-facing requirements. Not classified as ADR despite naming three forthcoming ADRs (003/004/005) — this document itself lacks the single-decision Status/Context/Decision/Consequences structure and is not a numbered ADR file; those decisions are recorded separately under docs/adr/. Also note sec 9 states the described work is already implemented/verified locally though not yet deployed, despite the doc framing itself as a pre-implementation proposal — a status/timeline inconsistency worth flagging to the synthesizer.
